g.text: Visitor history, assurance and connectivity shape floral investment
Model-conditional results; quantitative grid convergence is not established. 128 independent histories × 2 demographic repeats per arm.
Teal points: individual means, bars: 95% history-cluster intervals. Open orange squares / dotted lines: density means (not PDE).
Traits conditional on survival and defined initial states; numerical-gate and full denominator tables accompany this figure.
